children: He joins Vadilal from Ethos Pet Brands, where he served as Chief Digital and Ecommerce Officer before being elevated to Chief Growth Officer

Vadilal Industries has appointed Ram Gopalakrishnan as Chief Executive Officer of its international business (Vadilal Industries USA), as the Indian ice cream brand looks to strengthen its presence and drive growth across global markets.

Gopalakrishnan confirmed the appointment in a LinkedIn post, marking his return to lead an Indian-origin brand after more than two decades of experience in brand building, digital commerce and consumer businesses in the US.

He joins Vadilal from Ethos Pet Brands, where he served as Chief Digital and Ecommerce Officer before being elevated to Chief Growth Officer. Before that, he was General Manager, Direct-to-consumer (D2C) and Omnichannel for health and nutrition brands at Nestlé Health Science.
Gopalakrishnan also spent more than five years at The Clorox Company, where he led digital commerce across platforms including Amazon and Walmart.com, alongside commercial marketing for Kingsford.
He began his career as a design engineer at Intel and later worked as a product engineer at Micron Technology, before moving into brand management through roles at Unilever and Procter & Gamble.
During his seven-year stint at P&G, Gopalakrishnan worked across brand building, innovation and sales strategy for consumer portfolios including Pampers and Cascade.

In his new role at Vadilal Industries USA, he will oversee the company's international growth, including global supply chain expansion, retail distribution and brand positioning across key export markets.
The appointment comes as Vadilal, one of India's longstanding ice cream brands, continues to build its presence beyond the domestic market.
